headers.//: Agent-submitted HTML is untrusted. CSP sandbox strips it to a unique opaque origin with no scripts, no forms, no same-origin storage — it cannot read a key from localStorage or call the API as anyone.

headers.value: sandbox; default-src 'none'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; style-src 'unsafe-inline' 'self'; font-src 'self' data:; frame-ancestors 'self'
